text:
Asha: FYI I opened PR #8123 to refresh the quickstart tutorial (hello-world) — primary goals: switch examples to ephemeral auth, add a tiny Docker HEALTHCHECK, and include a one-line quicktest for impatient readers.
Mateo: Nice. Which ephemeral flow are we showing?
Asha: Short flow: user runs `redwood auth create-ephemeral --ttl 600` (we call out CLI is optional). Snippet shows how to set env var: `export REDWOOD_EPHEMERAL=$(redwood auth create-ephemeral)` then `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_EPHEMERAL" ...`. Kept an inline note about rotation and revocation.
Priya: Can we keep a single-line run for node/python, e.g., `REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(redwood auth create-ephemeral) node examples/server.js` so readers can try without installing extras?
Asha: Yep added a "Quick try" lateral box with one-liners for node/python/go/rust.
Kai: Heads up CI caught a Dockerfile lint (unused apt-get clean). I pushed a fix and added `HEALTHCHECK CMD curl -fsS http://localhost:8080/health || exit 1`.
Mateo: Great. doc-bot, run the link-checker?
doc-bot: running link-checker for branch docs/quickstart-refresh -> scanned 14 links, 1 broken (external tutorial page).
Asha: The external tutorial is a community blog; copied the minimal snippet inline and removed the outbound link.
Priya: I left a few wording nits around "ephemeral" -> "short-lived" consistency. Also suggested adding a tiny troubleshooting note when token creation fails (common on corporate proxies).
Asha: Added troubleshooting subsection and a curl timeout hint.
QA: Can we add a PR checklist item for a smoke test? Steps I propose: docker build, run container, curl /health, make a single example request using the one-liner. I can run it.
Mateo: Added QA checklist item to PR description and flagged QA-needed. Also requesting @Kai for Docker approval and @Priya for content.
Kai: Local docker build + healthcheck ok on ubuntu and mac. No perf impact.
Priya: Content review done, small copy edits pushed. Also swapped one US spelling for British (instant -> instantaneous) to be consistent.
doc-bot: CI: docs-lint passed, link-checker passed, docker-build passed, spellcheck flagged 1 style preference.
QA: Ran smoke steps  build OK, container healthy, quick request returned 200 with sample payload. All green.
Asha: Thanks everyone. I'll merge once CI finishes the last run. If maintainers want extra language screenshots or a GIF, file a follow-up PR.
doc-bot: Merged by Asha into main (PR #8123).
